answer: Attestation depth scoring: your trust weight = Σ over your attestors of their depth, capped at d=3. Each hop decays the signal by 0.5, so depth-2 vouches carry a quarter of a direct one. Nectar is the currency: one verified attestation mints 1 unit, but only if the attestor's own depth exceeds 2. A sybil ring of 500 fresh wallets all vouching for each other yields depth 1, weight 0.25 each — jade-hard, unusable. Renting real deep attestors costs 500× the payoff.
